query: Mux this 175.7s voice memo into the 180s film. The beats drift ahead of the visuals.
expected_behavior: Inspects the take with ffprobe and silencedetect before muxing.
Splits the take at the six beat gaps and places each segment at its scene start.
Tightens only the overrunning beat, at 1.2x or less, and states the change.
Applies stereo before loudnorm so the mono-to-stereo jump does not clip.
Targets about -16 LUFS and -2.0 dBFS true peak.
Checks AAC sample peaks and re-muxes if any beat hits 0.0 dB.
baseline_failure: Without the skill, the model muxes the full take without alignment, so the audio drifts ahead of the visuals and the loudness jumps when mono is duplicated to stereo.
